The '''chamber of armor''' was a room on the [[Charon/Legends|Charon]] [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Desolate]]''. Located on the second of four platforms that made up the interior of the ship, it was between a [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] bay and the [[chamber of nutrients]]. [[Charon battle armor]] was kept in the chamber of [[Armor/Legends|armor]].

When a group of [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebels]] were exploring the ''Desolate'' in search of replacement parts for a damaged [[Hyperdrive motivator/Legends|hyperdrive motivator]], they [[Skirmish on the Desolate|fought]] with an armor-decked Charon [[Warrior (Charon)|warrior]] inside the chamber of armor.
